name: amendment_a3
status: post-confirmatory descriptive; locked before any A3 download, preprocessing, inference or analysis
ensemble: mean of the ten fold softmax outputs in float64, then argmax

amplitude_rule.feature: standard deviation in microvolts of the 30 s epoch of the bandpass_v2 input
amplitude_rule.source: reference N2 and N3 epochs of the Sleep-EDF bandpass_v2 recordings; no target data
amplitude_rule.threshold: value among 999 pooled quantiles (0.001 to 0.999) of source N2 and N3 epochs that maximises the sum of the N3 rate at or above and the N2 rate below
amplitude_rule.R1_hard: an epoch whose predicted stage is N2 and whose feature is at or above the threshold is relabelled N3; nothing else changes
amplitude_rule.R2_soft: logistic regression of source N3 versus N2 on ln(feature) (scikit-learn, C=1e6, lbfgs); likelihood ratio = fitted odds divided by the source N3:N2 count ratio; the probability mass p(N2)+p(N3) of each epoch is redistributed with odds p(N3)/p(N2) multiplied by the likelihood ratio; other classes unchanged; then argmax
amplitude_rule.tunable_parameters: none; nothing is chosen on target data or on model performance
amplitude_rule.source_cost: on Sleep-EDF the rules are applied to out-of-fold predictions with threshold and regression fitted on the recordings outside the test fold

shhs1_holdout.status: already used in the confirmatory analysis, A1, A2 and the post-hoc stage-wise description
shhs1_holdout.arms: the ten arms above plus E4_s2025, E4_s2027, E4_s2029, E6R_s42, E6R_s123

sleep_edf_telemetry.status: never downloaded or examined by the authors before this lock
sleep_edf_telemetry.records: all 44 PSG/hypnogram pairs of 22 subjects, both nights (placebo and temazepam)
sleep_edf_telemetry.subject_rule: first five characters of the record key (ST7ss)
sleep_edf_telemetry.preprocessing: sleeptcn.preprocessing.process_record with the default PreprocessConfig, identical to Sleep-EDF SC

isruc_subgroup1.status: planned; data host unreachable at lock time (files now distributed through MEGA, 14.12 GB); run only when the raw recordings are obtained
isruc_subgroup1.records: all 100 subjects of subgroup I, raw .rec recordings (EDF), not the provider-filtered ExtractedChannels files
isruc_subgroup1.resampling: 200 Hz to 100 Hz, polyphase, up 1, down 2, Kaiser window beta 5.0, on the continuous signal before epoching
isruc_subgroup1.labels: scorer 1; 0 W, 1 N1, 2 N2, 3 N3, 5 REM; other values excluded
isruc_subgroup1.note: file parsing and unit checks are settled before any label is compared with a prediction; any change to this specification is reported as a deviation

interpretation_rules.replication: a contrast is said to replicate on a new cohort if its seed-42 interval for subject-mean macro-F1 lies above zero; seed 123 is reported beside it
interpretation_rules.rule_improves: interval of rule minus unmodified for subject-mean macro-F1 lies above zero
interpretation_rules.rule_trade_off: interval for N3 recall lies above zero and the interval for subject-mean macro-F1 includes zero
interpretation_rules.rule_harms: interval for subject-mean macro-F1 lies below zero
interpretation_rules.reporting: both rules, all arms and all cohorts including the source cost are reported whatever the outcome; no hypothesis tests
